confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, booking pages or 2026 listings. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation rates vary with season and booking channel. Cocktail and wine anchors are weakly known and were set relative to typical beer pricing. The FX figure comes from a search-result summary of the RBA table and was not verified on the live RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city was used. Prices are benchmarked to Chiang Mai's own tier within Thailand, placed below Bangkok, with food and drink reflecting local eateries and cafes and lodging reflecting the city's guesthouse and three-star hotel market.

anchor_basis.beer: one 330 ml Chang or Leo bottle at a local restaurant, about 100 baht
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a Nimman cafe, about 85 baht
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: khao soi with chicken at a neighbourhood eatery, about 75 baht
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course dinner for two (starter, main, dessert, no drinks) at a mid-range restaurant, about 1,400 baht total
anchor_basis.cocktail: classic cocktail such as a gin and tonic at a Nimman bar, about 220 baht
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house red or white by the glass at a mid-range restaurant, about 210 baht
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: bed in a 6 to 8 bed dorm at a registered Old City hostel, about 350 baht a night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a registered hostel, about 900 baht a night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room at a registered guesthouse with fan or air conditioning, about 600 baht a night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room at a registered three-star hotel in Nimman or the Old City, about 2,250 baht a night
